# Plugin.Maui.NfcPlus

Session-based NFC for .NET MAUI on Android and iOS. NDEF text / URI / MIME read and write, tag IDs, foreground dispatch / CoreNFC sessions, and availability detection. Not a hardware-only probe.

Repository: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.NfcPlus
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.NfcPlus
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-nfc-plus
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

Platforms: Android, iOS. Mac Catalyst and Windows are not primary targets.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.NfcPlus

Registration: `UseNfcPlus` — see README.md.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I read an NFC tag in .NET MAUI?
- How do I write NDEF text / URI / MIME on Android and iOS?
- NFC tag ID for attendance, assets, or vehicle inspection
- Foreground dispatch / iOS NFC session from MAUI
- Detect whether NFC is available or turned off

## Do not use when

- The app only needs to know if NFC hardware exists (use Plugin.Maui.DeviceInfoPlus)
- The app needs HCE, MIFARE Classic keys, or payments
- Windows or Mac Catalyst is a required target
